```{r}
rabbits <- function(n, k){
  p1 <- 1 #pairs always start at 1
  p2 <- 1
  if (n == 1 | n == 2){
    p3 <- 1
  }
  else{
    months_vec <- seq(n-2)
    for (i in months_vec){
      p3 <- p1 * k + p2
      p1 <- p2
      p2 <- p3 
    }
  }
  return(p3)
}
```

```{r}
rabbits(28,3)
```
